main:28.text: This section/page depicts all cutscenes and dialogues in the mission "Street Sweeper" in Grand Theft Auto IV.

main:46.text: Paparazzo - The Meltdown is a Strangers and Freaks mission given to protagonist Franklin Clinton by Beverly Felton. Franklin enters a marked area in Downtown Vinewood. Upon entering the area and a call from Beverly, Franklin sees a sports car rush past with police cars in hot pursuit. Beverly calls Franklin, who informs him that the police are chasing actress Poppy Mitchell, who is supposedly drunk.
